plainText:
Drake's Dragonite (Japanese: ユウジのカイリュー Yūji's Kairyu) is 's main Pokémon in . Drake keeps 's around his neck.

==In animation==
===Pokémon the Series===
==== ====
 
Dragonite first appeared in Hello, Pummelo!, when it was seen flying around Pummelo Island. Later, when tried to steal Dragonite, they were sent blasting off from its attack.

In Enter The Dragonite, Drake used Dragonite as his final Pokémon in his Full Battle against . It was shown to be a very strong battler. With its impressive speed and power, it was able to take out , , and , although all three managed to land at least one blow on Dragonite before they fainted. Even though it fought three of Ash's Pokémon, it was still able to defeat Team Rocket when they tried another attempt at capturing it when it was tired out. 

It then had to battle in the last round of the match. Despite being tired out from the previous battles, it managed to put up a good fight against Pikachu, but, after a fierce battle, it was defeated by Pikachu's use of a attack while positioned on Dragonite's head, making Ash an Honored Trainer of the Orange League.

===Personality and characteristics===
Drake's Dragonite is truly a force to be reckoned with. Drake holds his Dragonite in high regard, even keeping a modeled statue of it and its around his neck, a testament to their bond. This particular Dragonite is renowned for its unyielding stamina and incredible resilience, consistently overpowering numerous trainers before its clash with Ash. It's a testament to its indomitable spirit that, even after a grueling battle against four of Ash's Pokémon, including a tough struggle against Charizard, Dragonite still possessed the might to defeat half of Ash's team. Despite being tired from its prior victories, Dragonite enough fourth Pokémon to faced Ash's Pikachu, putting up a fierce battle before finally being defeated by a strategic Thunder attack.

===The Electric Tale of Pikachu===
Dragonite makes an appearance in Pikachu's Plan, where it was the last Pokémon Drake used to battle . It went up against as its first opponent and won easily. was next, and after a long battle, Dragonite emerged victorious. Lastly, it battled and lost when Pikachu crawled into its mouth and used , giving Ash the victory.

====Moves used====
 
 
 
 
 

==Trivia==
According to Atsuhiro Tomioka in his comments in "The Memorial Book of Orange Islands", he had a hard time writing down the scene(s) of Dragonite that depicted it as a ridiculously strong opponent for . This may refer to the fact that Dragonite used ten different moves during one episode.
